reason: Revised the specification to v003, carrying forward all unchallenged content from v002. Comment 104677 (feedback token SDLC-8-SPEC-v2, item F1) asked to add lazy loading of cards on scroll, but this conflicts with the ticket's own exclusions (no animations, no behaviour change) and its styling-only framing, and the task list is a fixed 12-item array with no backend, so there is no loading cost to defer. Rather than silently applying or dropping it, this is raised as Q1 for human review; the draft adds it to Exclusions pending an answer and does not add new scope or acceptance criteria for it. No other changes to scope, acceptance criteria or assumptions were needed.
